classification_branch.decision: Do not calibrate or deploy. The validation-selected policy missed at least one unchanged held-out test event.

robust_forecasting_branch.decision: Do not construct a readiness score. Persistence remained best at 48 and 72 hours.

exploratory_24h_forecast.restriction: Display only as an exploratory hive-weight forecast. It must not be translated into honey maturity or a harvest decision.

approved_dashboard_sections: Validation alert-policy eligibility with held-out test miss
decision.research_statement: The validation-selected alert policy detected both reviewed validation events but missed the unchanged held-out test event. Robust forecasting improved only the 24-hour horizon, while persistence remained best at 48 and 72 hours. The module is therefore retained as a benchmark and prospective-validation prototype.
decision.next_research_stage: Prospectively collect beekeeper-confirmed harvest events, pre- and post-harvest weights, harvested honey mass, comb capping observations and honey moisture.
decision.robust_target_definition: The target is the difference between a trailing-median weight endpoint at t+h and a trailing-median endpoint at t.

classification.research_stage: Model comparison completed. Probabilities are not yet calibrated and must not yet be presented as HUI.
classification.selection_rule: Require the configured validation event recall when possible; then maximize validation PR-AUC, minimize false-alert episodes, prefer fewer features and prefer the simpler model in a tie.
warnings: The 12 reviewed hive-level events correspond to a smaller number of temporal harvest sessions.
Validation contains two events and test contains one event; all performance claims must state these counts.
The current output probabilities are uncalibrated model scores. HUI will be implemented only after training-only calibration.
The target represents probable harvest activity within 72 hours, not independently verified optimal honey maturity.

alert_policy_gate.warning: Validation contains two events and test contains one event; any later calibration remains provisional.

robust_forecasting_summary.selection_rule: Minimize validation MAE, then median absolute error, absolute bias and model complexity.
warnings: This reformulation reduces endpoint sensor noise but does not verify honey maturity.
The readiness prototype remains blocked unless the research gate passes.

robust_forecasting_gate.interpretation: This gate checks whether future-weight forecasting adds measurable value beyond persistence before a readiness prototype is constructed.

robust_forecasting_gate.research_decision: Proceed to the provisional readiness prototype only when ready_for_readiness_prototype is true. Do not lower the gate after seeing these results.
